tagline: DRAM, NAND and high-bandwidth memory (HBM) for AI data centers, PCs, mobile and embedded.

notes: Q4 DRAM revenue $39.8B and NAND $14.1B; HBM revenue grew faster than total company revenue in Q4.

Guided ~$25B of capex for H1 FY27 (vs $27.4B for all of FY26).

calls.text: Consensus Strong Buy across 49 analysts; average target $1,561.91 (+78.0% vs the Oct 23 close)

catalysts.event: HBM bit supply mostly contracted at higher prices; NVHBM with NVIDIA in development

bull.text: FY26 revenue +256% with ~81% gross margin and $59B of free cash flow
Most of CY2027 HBM supply already contracted at higher prices
Forward P/E ~6× with Street targeting ~$1,555 (~43% upside)
Net cash ~$68B; board declared another $0.15 dividend

bear.text: Memory is cyclical: new supply can reverse pricing and margins quickly
Capex stepping up to ~$25B in H1 FY27 alone — cash conversion may compress
Customer and HBM concentration risk if AI buildout slows

news.title: Micron drops 5% as Intel's weak guidance deepens the chip selloff
news.summary: Intel fell about 29% after a weak Q4 outlook overshadowed a Q3 beat, and Amazon's free-cash-flow decline amid heavy AI spending added to worries about the AI trade. AMD and Marvell fell by double digits, Broadcom and Micron more than 5%, and the iShares Semiconductor ETF more than 8%; SanDisk dropped 13%. The Nasdaq fell 5.3% in October, its worst month since March 2025. MU closed down 5.30% at $884.74.

news.title: Micron falls as Samsung's post-earnings selloff spreads to memory peers
news.summary: Samsung posted a fourth straight record quarter (revenue ₩195.3T, operating profit ₩107.4T) but net profit of ₩75.1T missed the ₩86.1T FactSet consensus, and its shares fell more than 4% in Seoul. Alphabet's weak results and lighter-than-expected Microsoft and Alphabet capex added to chip-stock pressure. Samsung reiterated that tight memory supply should last several years. MU closed down 4.98% at $934.27.

news.title: SK Hynix's record quarter lifts Micron and Sandisk
news.summary: SK Hynix reported record Q3 revenue of ₩104.6T (about $77.9B, +32% QoQ), with DRAM prices up in the high-20% range and NAND prices up mid-20% QoQ, and guided Q4 DRAM revenue up another 20%+; operating profit rose 632% YoY. Sandisk reports Thursday. MU closed up 5.86% at $983.23.

news.title: Memory stocks rise as Anthropic's S-1 shows about $450B of compute commitments
news.summary: Anthropic's public filing showed first-half revenue of $16.3B and plans to spend about $450B on cloud computing deals over 7-10 years, lifting memory names; SK Hynix rose 5.6% in Seoul. SK Hynix (Wednesday) and Samsung (Thursday) report next. MU closed up 2.77% at $928.76.

news.title: BofA reiterates Buy on Micron, 'incrementally more positive' on memory after management meetings
news.summary: BofA's Vivek Arya kept a Buy and $1,550 target, saying memory supply should tighten further in 2027 and 2028 with no meaningful DRAM/NAND oversupply expected through 2028; Micron's 3–5 year contracts now cover about 35% of sales. MU closed up 3.0% at $903.70.

news.title: Micron rebounds with memory stocks as SK Hynix scraps its Solidigm IPO
news.summary: MU rose more than 2% Friday as the SOX recovered from Thursday's 6.7% drop. LYNX said SK Hynix's cancelled Solidigm IPO removes a NAND capacity overhang; D.A. Davidson reiterated Buy with a $3,000 target.

news.title: Micron falls 6.3% as Tesla's capex cut, Lam's forecast and AI-funding worries hit chips
news.summary: Micron closed down 6.3% in a sector-wide selloff along with Intel and AMD (about −8%), Nvidia (−4.4%) and Sandisk (−8.5%). The Taoyuan union's 24-hour symbolic strike ran until 9 a.m. Friday Taiwan time with no confirmed production disruption; Micron Taiwan said the Taichung deal adds a quarterly profit-sharing bonus.

news.title: Micron Taoyuan union officials begin a 24-hour symbolic strike after a deal with the Taichung union
news.summary: Eleven Taoyuan union officials began a one-day strike at 9 a.m. Thursday that the union said is not meant to disrupt production. Micron signed an agreement with the larger Taichung union on Oct. 21 (terms undisclosed); Taoyuan talks resume Friday. The union seeks 15% of operating profit for profit-sharing.

news.title: Micron reaches a deal with its Taichung union, but Taoyuan union proceeds with a strike
news.summary: TrendForce said Taoyuan focuses on front-end DRAM wafers while Taichung makes advanced DRAM and HBM; if the action lasts only a day and critical production stays normal, the supply impact would likely be limited.

news.title: Micron faces a planned strike at its Taoyuan, Taiwan site on Thursday, Oct. 22
news.summary: The Taoyuan union, seeking a bonus plan worth 15% of operating profit, said 1,994 members (99% of those voting) backed strike action in support of workers at Micron's Taichung site. The length of the walkout is unclear.

news.title: Micron invests in Indium Corporation's New York critical-minerals processing
news.summary: Strategic funding under Micron's up-to-$3B US supply-chain plan will expand Indium's refining and manufacturing in Rome, N.Y., with a long-term supply agreement giving Micron access to high-purity minerals for advanced memory.

news.title: Micron closes up 3% at $904.90 as dip buyers return to memory stocks
news.summary: Micron rose as much as 4.2% after shedding about 11% last week on AI-spending and CXMT competition worries; COO Manish Bhatia recently said 2027 capacity at the Taichung fab is sold out. Its Taoyuan union has secured the legal right to strike after an 88.3% vote, though no strike has been called; a Taichung mediation session is set for Oct. 22.

listContext.method: Conservative growth at a reasonable price (GARP), rerun on the full US-listed market (StockAnalysis / S&P Global screener, Oct 30, 2026 close). A stock qualifies if it has: market cap of $10B or more and at least a year of trading history; TTM revenue growth of 15% or more that analysts expect to continue (consensus revenue growth of 8%+ next fiscal year and 8%+ a year over the next 3 years); a positive forward P/E of 35 or less and a PEG of 1.5 or less where available; a Buy or Strong Buy consensus from 5+ analysts with 15%+ upside to the average target; beta of 2.6 or less; share count up no
